summary.text: Julia Coleman is a Republican state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 48 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Julia Coleman lives in Chanhassen, Minnesota, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota in 2014.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as owning a business.
Coleman represented Minnesota Senate District 47 from 2021 to 2023 and has represented District 48 since January 3, 2023, succeeding Steve Cwodzinski.
